Under legacy semantics, `"auto"` resolves to `"multiindex"`, so `_as_model_snapshots` leaves the supplied index unchanged. If `create_model` builds over only a subset of the network’s snapshots, `solve_model` nevertheless supplies all of `n.snapshots` to `_call_extra_functionality`, which forwards them unchanged rather than using the model’s stored snapshots.
